;;;; Frame layouts per protocol version.

(defpackage #:kc6.codec (:use #:cl))
(in-package #:kc6.codec)

(defun frame-layout (version)
  (let ((table (list :magic #x7643)))
    (ecase version
      (:v1 (list* :header 12 table))
      (:v2 (list* :header 16 table)))))

(defun read-forms (path)
  (with-open-file (in path)
    (loop for form = (read in nil in) until (eq form in) collect form)))

(defun fail (why) (format t "FAIL: ~a~%" why) (sb-ext:exit :code 1))

(let* ((forms (handler-case (read-forms "codec.lisp")
                (error (c) (fail (format nil "codec.lisp does not read: ~a" c)))))
       (defun-form (find-if (lambda (f) (and (consp f) (eq (first f) 'defun))) forms))
       (let-form (first (cdddr defun-form)))
       (ecase-form (first (cddr let-form))))
  (unless (and (consp let-form) (eq (first let-form) 'let)) (fail "the let is gone"))
  (unless (equal (second let-form) '((table (list :magic #x7643)))) (fail "the let binding changed"))
  (unless (and (consp ecase-form) (eq (first ecase-form) 'ecase)) (fail "the ecase is gone"))
  (let ((clauses (cddr ecase-form)))
    (unless (= 3 (length clauses)) (fail (format nil "ecase has ~d clauses, want 3" (length clauses))))
    (unless (equal (first clauses) '(:v1 (list* :header 12 table))) (fail ":v1 changed"))
    (unless (equal (second clauses) '(:v2 (list* :header 16 table))) (fail ":v2 changed"))
    (unless (equal (third clauses) '(:v3 (list* :header 24 table)))
      (fail (format nil ":v3 is ~s, want (:v3 (list* :header 24 table))" (third clauses))))))
(format t "ok~%")
